tagline: One of the world's oldest living cities, Varanasi lines the sacred Ganges with ghats, temples and the nightly Ganga Aarti fire ceremony.
overview: Varanasi, also called Benares or Kashi, is on the banks of the Ganges in Uttar Pradesh and is one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in the world. It is the holiest city in Hinduism, and pilgrims come to bathe in the river and to be cremated here.

More than 80 ghats, stone steps leading down to the water, line the river. At Dashashwamedh Ghat, priests perform the Ganga Aarti each evening with fire, bells and chanting, while Manikarnika Ghat is the main cremation site. The Kashi Vishwanath Temple is one of the most sacred temples to Shiva.

Sunrise boat rides show the city waking up along the river. Nearby Sarnath is where the Buddha gave his first sermon. Varanasi is also known for silk Banarasi saris, classical music and street food such as kachori and lassi.
